name: Pocket faces
note: The faces that turn up when something goes wrong, as the Game Boy Camera had them: the residents, scribbled over.

stickers.gloss: Thuan, fuming, scribbled over: angry brows, a cross over one eye, a spiral on her cheek
Thao, shushing, scribbled over: round glasses and a curly moustache

stickers.line: Well. That did not go to plan.
stickers.gloss: Thuan, jaw dropped, scribbled over: sweat drops, a scrawl on the forehead, stubble
Johansson, huffing, scribbled over: devil horns, a monocle, a spiral on his cheek

stickers.line: Thirty photos. A Game Boy Camera would be full by now.
stickers.gloss: Johansson, aghast, scribbled over: tears and a zigzag mouth
Thao, ta-da, scribbled over: a party hat, stars and blush lines
Thuan, rolling her eyes, scribbled over: glasses, a beard and a sweat drop

stickers.line: That is not going to work.
stickers.gloss: Johansson, thinking, scribbled over: a cross over one eye, a moustache and horns
